entities.summary: Cameron Gaunce is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently an unrestricted free agent. He most recently played under contract with Fehérvár AV19 of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). Gaunce was selected by Colorado Avalanche in the second round, 50th overall, of the 2008 NHL Entry Draft.
